title: Galehigh Terraces - Updraft
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. Vesper motif (A3->D4->E4 lift overshooting to E, then F#4->E4->D4 settle) chopped into staccato kite-hops, overshoot landing on a cheeky offbeat. Driving altitude route. Noise gust swell crests and cuts every 4 bars (the wind). 16-bar loop, last bar voice-leads (A on the and-of-4) back to the bar-1 lift.
